architecture_summary: React Vite Tailwind app. Core pages: Dashboard, Courses, Students, Reports. Auth flow: login, register, password reset. State: React Context + localStorage. API: mock Axios client. Styling: Tailwind CSS. Routing: React Router v6. Build: Vite. Testing: Vitest + React Testing Library. Lint: ESLint + Prettier.

tickets.title: Create base layout shell (src/layouts/BaseLayout.jsx)
tickets.description: Build base layout with header, sidebar, main content area. Header: logo, user dropdown. Sidebar: navigation links (Dashboard, Courses, Students, Reports). Mobile responsive. Use Tailwind.
acceptance_criteria: Header show logo and user dropdown
Navigation links active state highlight current route

tickets.title: Implement Dashboard page (src/pages/Dashboard.jsx)
tickets.description: Build dashboard with stats cards, recent activity, quick actions. Stats cards: total courses, students, completion rate. Recent activity: table with last 5 enrollments. Quick actions: buttons for common tasks. Use Tailwind for styling.

tickets.title: Build Courses page (src/pages/Courses.jsx)
tickets.description: Create courses page with list view, search, filter, pagination. List view: table with course name, instructor, students, status. Search: input field. Filter: dropdown for status. Pagination: 10 items per page. Use Tailwind.

tickets.title: Implement Students page (src/pages/Students.jsx)
tickets.description: Build students page with list view, search, enrollment status filter. List view: table with student name, email, enrolled courses, progress. Search: input field. Filter: dropdown for enrollment status. Use Tailwind.

tickets.title: Create Reports page (src/pages/Reports.jsx)
tickets.description: Build reports page with chart, export options. Chart: course completion rate (bar chart). Export: buttons for CSV, PDF. Use Tailwind + Chart.js for visualization.

tickets.title: Implement auth pages (src/pages/auth/*)
tickets.description: Build login, register, password reset pages. Login: email, password, submit. Register: name, email, password, confirm password. Password reset: email input, submit. Use Tailwind for styling. Form validation: required fields, email format, password match.
acceptance_criteria: Submit buttons trigger mock auth flow

tickets.title: Set up mock API client (src/api/mockClient.js)
tickets.description: Create mock Axios client for auth, courses, students, reports. Return mock data for all endpoints. Use MSW for mocking during development.
acceptance_criteria: Mock client return data for all endpoints

tickets.title: App shell and navigation wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Set up React Router. Routes: auth (login, register, password reset), main (dashboard, courses, students, reports). Auth guard: redirect to login if not authenticated. Use BaseLayout for main routes. Error boundary: 404 page.
